notes:
v0.6.19: BUILD.md — pre-seed DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive for apt install.

Caught during operator's clean build on reticulumpi: `apt
install` paused on a dpkg prompt for
`/etc/initramfs-tools/initramfs.conf` (locally-modified by
ReticulumHF base, .deb ships an updated version). Operator
pressed N (keep current), which is the right answer for
this case, but a different operator might press Y and get
a working-but-different initramfs config, or pause on
every fresh build.

The fix: pre-set `DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive` before
any apt install block. dpkg keeps the locally-modified
config (same as N at the prompt) but never blocks the
build. Also avoids any future prompts from openssh-server,
avahi-daemon, etc.

This is the right answer for all our overlay packages:
- initramfs-tools: keep current (ReticulumHF base is fine)
- openssh-server: keep current (we use password auth)
- avahi-daemon: keep current (mDNS config is correct)

No code or overlay changes. Docs only.
